messages.name: allparams
messages.digest: Output the values of all parameters in a patch as an OSC bundle
messages.description: Generate an OSC bundle containing the values of every parameter in a patch.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: param.osc accepts normal Max messages that represent OSC, for example: /param/live.gain~ -18.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Then bang message will cause param.osc to output OSC according to the outputmode.

messages.name: FullPacket
messages.description: An OSC packet containing messages to be dispatched to parameters in the patch.

messages.name: info
messages.digest: Extended info about all parameters in a patch as an OSC bundle
messages.description: Generate an OSC bundle containing comprehensive info about every parameter in the patch, for example the long name, short name, minimum, maximum, etc.

messages.name: param
messages.digest: Output the value(s) of the most recently changed parameter as an OSC bundle
messages.description: Generate an OSC bundle containing the value of the most recently changed parameter.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Dispatch OSC to parameters without triggering output.
messages.description: Dispatches OSC to parameters without triggering output from param.osc or UDP if enabled.
